note: Sept 23 2026. The two clips the room plays itself, voiced for Nerra Voices. Until now both shows played age_of_ai/system/mira_disclosure.mp3, so every Nerra Voices guest was greeted with 'the AI host for the Age of AI' before Mira introduced herself correctly eleven seconds later. The disclosure is the consent notice and has to be said plainly and first; the apology is played only if her connection drops and cannot be rescued. The fire step uses these once they exist (shows/nerra_voices.yaml voices.disclosure_clip / apology_clip) and keeps the shared clips until then, because a consent notice with the wrong show name is better than none.

segments.text: Hi, this is Mira, the AI host of Nerra Voices on the Nerra Network. This conversation is being recorded for the podcast. By staying on, you confirm your consent to be recorded. Let's begin.

I'm so sorry. I've lost my connection and I can't carry on the conversation right now. Everything we recorded is safe, and nothing goes out without you hearing it first. We'll be in touch to finish this properly. Thank you for your patience.
